name: ksweather_get_current_weather
description: Fetches the current weather conditions for a specified location including temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind speed, and pressure. Location must be valid (village/district/GPS). This is a PUBLIC tool — no authentication required. Does NOT provide forecasts — use ksweather_get_weather_forecast. Fails if location is invalid, ambiguous, or no data is available. Data reflects near real-time conditions but may be slightly delayed.

name: ksweather_get_weather_forecast
description: Retrieves weather forecast for a location for up to 10 days. Returns predicted temperature, rainfall, humidity, and wind. Forecasts are reliable up to 7-10 days only. PUBLIC tool — no authentication needed. Does NOT provide current conditions — use ksweather_get_current_weather. Fails if location is invalid or forecast data is unavailable. Forecasts are predictive and may change.

name: ksweather_get_weather_alerts
description: Fetches active extreme weather alerts (storms, heavy rainfall, heatwaves, cold waves, frost) for a location. PUBLIC tool. Returns alert severity, type, and validity period. Does NOT provide agricultural advisory — use ksweather_get_weather_advisory. Fails if location is invalid. Returns empty if no active alerts exist. Old/expired alerts are NOT returned.

name: ksweather_get_location_weather
description: Fetches comprehensive weather data for a specific location combining current conditions and short-term outlook. PUBLIC tool. Resolves ambiguous location names to the most probable match. Does NOT provide historical data. Fails if location cannot be resolved or data is unavailable.

weather_parameter.description: Specific parameter. Allowed: 'temperature', 'rainfall', 'humidity', 'wind_speed', 'pressure'. Optional — returns all if omitted.

name: ksweather_get_weather_parameters
description: Retrieves specific weather parameters for a location with detailed measurements. PUBLIC tool. Returns data_status ('available', 'partial', 'not_available'). Does NOT provide forecasts or advisories. Fails if the parameter type is unsupported or location is invalid.

name: ksweather_get_historical_weather
description: Retrieves historical weather data for a location for the recent past (last 7-30 days only). PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide forecasts or real-time data. Fails if location is invalid or historical data is unavailable for the requested period. Data may be partial for some regions.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be within last 30 days.

name: ksweather_resolve_location_ambiguity
description: Resolves ambiguous location names that match multiple regions. Returns a list of possible locations with state/district disambiguation. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide weather data — use other tools after resolving. Fails if the input does not match any known location.

location.description: Ambiguous village or district name to resolve.

name: ksweather_get_weather_advisory
description: Generates weather-based advisory for farming activities (irrigation timing, spraying, harvesting) based on current and forecasted weather. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide crop-specific advisory — use ATMA tools for that. Fails if location is invalid or weather data is insufficient for advisory generation.

name: ksweather_subscribe_alerts
description: Subscribes the farmer to weather alerts for a specific location. Transitions subscription_status to 'subscribed'. Requires session_token (authenticated). Does NOT provide actual alerts — use ksweather_get_weather_alerts. Fails if already subscribed or session_token is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.

name: ksweather_unsubscribe_alerts
description: Unsubscribes the farmer from weather alerts. Transitions subscription_status to 'unsubscribed'. Requires session_token. Does NOT affect already-received alerts. Fails if not currently subscribed.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.

name: ksweather_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance about weather data quality. Valid categories: 'incorrect_forecast', 'missing_weather_data', 'delayed_update', 'wrong_location', 'alert_not_received'. Farmer must verify data first. Requires session_token. Does NOT correct data. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.

name: ksweather_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks a previously raised weather grievance. Returns resolution status and remarks. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.
